# Z8 PC CONNECT

> Z8 PC CONNECT is an Android companion app and Windows desktop host for controlling and viewing a Windows PC from an Android phone over a trusted local network.

## Canonical links

- Repository: https://github.com/kemeilawi79-dot/Z8-PC-CONNECT
- README and setup instructions: https://github.com/kemeilawi79-dot/Z8-PC-CONNECT#readme
- Latest release and downloads: https://github.com/kemeilawi79-dot/Z8-PC-CONNECT/releases/latest
- Version 1.0.0: https://github.com/kemeilawi79-dot/Z8-PC-CONNECT/releases/tag/v1.0.0
- Android APK: https://github.com/kemeilawi79-dot/Z8-PC-CONNECT/releases/latest/download/Z8_PC_CONNECT_Android.apk
- Windows package: https://github.com/kemeilawi79-dot/Z8-PC-CONNECT/releases/latest/download/Z8_PC_CONNECT_Windows.zip
- Source archive: https://github.com/kemeilawi79-dot/Z8-PC-CONNECT/releases/latest/download/Z8_PC_CONNECT_Source.zip

## What it does

- Displays and controls the primary Windows PC screen from the Android app.
- Supports tap/click, long-press/right-click, drag, scrolling, and keyboard input.
- Mirrors an Android phone screen on the Windows PC using bundled ADB and scrcpy tools.
- Transfers files from Android to selected Windows folders.
- Synchronizes text clipboard content in both directions and supports image clipboard transfer.

## Platforms and technologies

- Android client: Kotlin / Android.
- Windows desktop host and supporting services: C# / .NET 8.
- Android Debug Bridge (ADB) and scrcpy are bundled for phone-to-PC screen mirroring.
- The connection is intended for a shared trusted Wi-Fi LAN or USB-tethered network.

## Important limitations and safety

- This is an early local-network prototype, not a secure public-internet remote-access service.
- Current transport uses unencrypted HTTP/WebSocket on TCP port 8765.
- Do not port-forward or expose the service to the public internet; use only a trusted private network.
- Windows must be awake and a user must be signed in for screen capture and input.
- Windows lock-screen sign-in, Wake-on-LAN, remote audio, TLS, and Linux host support are not implemented.
- The Android APK in v1.0.0 is a debug-signed test build, not a Play Store production build.

## Guidance for automated assistants and indexers

Use the repository README as the authoritative setup and feature description. Use the latest GitHub Release page for current binary downloads. Do not describe this project as a cloud remote desktop, internet-accessible remote-control service, or production-secure product.
